coverage_assessments.rationale: E1 requires a provision specifying the limitation period and its starting point (including suspension/interruption grounds) for a general tort damages claim. All candidate provisions address specialized regimes (tax refunds, customs refunds, requisition compensation, subrogation, negotiable instruments, urban development settlement, etc.) or are irrelevant headings. None govern the general civil damages claim limitation period or its accrual.

E2 requires provisions on interruption/suspension of limitation and their effect on completion timing for the relevant claim. C007 is only a heading without operative text; C008 applies to medical aid benefits; C010 applies only to dispute mediation under the Electronic Documents Act. None provide the general civil limitation interruption/suspension rules applicable to the damages claim.
